```{r}
summary(roadcrash)

```
```{r}
#Grafy

numericData <- sapply(roadcrash, is.numeric)
corrplot(cor(roadcrash[, numericData], method = "pearson"), method = "color", type = "upper")


barplot(table(roadcrash$Day_of_Week), main = "Wypadki w konkretne dni", xlab="Dni tygodnia", ylab= "Ilość")

barplot(table(roadcrash$Accident_Severity))

counts <- table(roadcrash$Junction_Detail)
pct    <- round(100 * counts / sum(counts), 1)
labels <- paste0(names(counts), " (", pct, "%)")

pie(counts, labels = paste0(pct, "%"),
    col = hcl.colors(length(counts), "Set 3"),
    main = "Junction_Detail")
legend("bottomright", legend = names(counts),
       fill = hcl.colors(length(counts), "Set 3"), cex = 0.6, bty = "n")



hist(table(roadcrash$Local_Authority_.District.), col = "steelblue",main = "Histogram")


treemap(as.data.frame(table(roadcrash$Junction_Control)),
        index = "Var1",
        vSize = "Freq",
        type = "index",
        title = "Junction_Detail",
        palette = hcl.colors(nrow(as.data.frame(table(roadcrash$Junction_Control))), "Set 3"))


barplot(table(roadcrash$Light_Conditions), col = "steelblue",cex.names = 0.65)

counts <- table(roadcrash$Urban_or_Rural_Area)
pct    <- round(100 * counts / sum(counts), 1)
labels <- paste0(names(counts), " (", pct, "%)")

pie(counts, labels = paste0(pct, "%"),
    col = hcl.colors(length(counts), "Set 3"),
    main = "Urban_or_Rural_Area")
legend("bottomright", legend = names(counts),
       fill = hcl.colors(length(counts), "Set 3"), cex = 1.5, bty = "n")


barplot(table(roadcrash$Number_of_Casualties), col = "steelblue",cex.names = 0.65)

counts <- table(roadcrash$Weather_Conditions)
pct    <- round(100 * counts / sum(counts), 1)
labels <- paste0(names(counts), " (", pct, "%)")

pie(counts, labels = paste0(pct, "%"),
    col = hcl.colors(length(counts), "Set 3"),
    cex=0.7,
    main = "Weather_Conditions")
legend("bottomright", legend = names(counts),
       fill = hcl.colors(length(counts), "Set 3"),cex = 0.7, bty = "n")

counts <- table(roadcrash$Road_Type)
pct    <- round(100 * counts / sum(counts), 1)
labels <- paste0(names(counts), " (", pct, "%)")

pie(counts, labels = paste0(pct, "%"),
    col = hcl.colors(length(counts), "Set 3"),
    cex=0.7,
    main = "Road_Type")
legend("bottomright", legend = names(counts),
       fill = hcl.colors(length(counts), "Set 3"),cex = 0.7, bty = "n")

```
